newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASX says problems with SEATS trading system.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASX says problems with SEATS trading system.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) said on Wednesday its Stock Exchange Automated Trading System (SEATS) had been unable to process transactions due to a technical problem.
A spokesman from the ASX said the system would be available from 9.20 a.m. (2220 GMT).
Operators are usually able to enter pre-open positions between 9.00 a.m. (2200 GMT) and 10.00 a.m. (2300 GMT) when the market official opens.
